comparison.objective: Sort three waste items into the correct lidded bins and close both lids.
comparison.physical_skill: Hinged-lid access, semantic sorting, containment, and closure.
comparison.success_condition: All items in correct bins and lids closed; wrong-bin entry permanently fails, though exact thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Waste sorting and lid handling are unrelated to two-tool angular adjustment locking.
